basics.name: Abdul Aziz Zailani
basics.label: Senior Site Reliability Engineer & DevOps Platform Lead
basics.summary: Senior SRE & DevOps Platform Engineer with 7+ years of experience engineering high-availability multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud) and enterprise container platforms (Kubernetes EKS/GKE). Proven track record executing zero-downtime production migrations, auto-scaling runner fleets (ARC), Jenkins-as-Code (JCasC) standardization, and reducing incident MTTR by 50% via distributed observability. Adept at eliminating operational toil through IaC and custom automation in Go and Python.

work.name: PT. Lion Express (Lion Parcel)
work.summary: Managing reliability, high availability, and multi-cloud resilience (AWS & GCP) hosting core logistics and parcel delivery microservices across Indonesia.
highlights: Zero-Downtime Cloud Migration: Led and executed end-to-end multi-cloud migration of 100% core logistics microservices and databases from GCP to AWS EKS with zero service interruption (0% downtime).

GitHub Actions Scale Sets (ARC): Architected and deployed GitHub Actions Runner Controller (ARC) on AWS EKS to manage auto-scaling self-hosted runner fleets, reducing pipeline build wait times by 40% and saving 30% runner infrastructure costs.

Jenkins-as-Code (JCasC): Standardized enterprise CI/CD pipelines utilizing JCasC and Job DSL configurations, improving deployment speed by 25% and embedding automated quality gates directly into runtime.
Distributed Observability: Deployed Grafana Tempo distributed tracing stack with AWS S3 backend across all environments, reducing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) by 50% for production incidents.
